prompt: Create a new Python library called acme-utils with pytest, ruff and CI ready to go.
rubric_items: Runs skills/python/project-setup/scripts/create_project.py (or equivalent steps) from a scratch parent directory, producing a src-layout package directory
pyproject.toml exists with [project] metadata, a build backend, and a src/<package>/py.typed marker
A tests/ directory exists and the generated test passes when pytest is run
Ruff lint and format checks pass on the generated project
.github/workflows contains a CI workflow that runs lint and tests
The helper is not run inside the skills repository checkout, leaving no stray generated directory
setup: Materialize into a new directory outside the skills repository checkout; that directory is the scratch parent.
Start the agent with its working directory at the materialized directory, with the skill installed, and give it the prompt verbatim.
Do not pre-install anything. Python 3.12 and uv are assumed available.
expected_observations: Before the trial the parent contains only PARENT.md: no pyproject.toml, src/ or acme_utils/ directory.
After the trial a new child directory (for example acme-utils/) holds the generated package; PARENT.md is untouched.
Assess each listed rubric item against that child directory and the transcript; the generated project's own pytest and ruff commands give the exit statuses.
Nothing is generated inside the skills repository checkout.
